purpose: Capture byte-identical Btrieve/MKDE transaction and recovery artifacts before and after controlled operations without inventing their record formats.
controlled_capture_sequence: perform exactly one documented MajorMUD mutation
snapshot after clean commit or shutdown
compare stable changed offsets across independent captures
perform forced-termination capture only in an isolated duplicate installation
closure_impact: Provides the reproducible acquisition and comparison path required to enrich the conclusively bounded TRN/RCV format boundary when artifacts become available.
